name: cdm/product/template/SchedulePeriod
description: A class that defines the period of a schedule. The period contains a set of start and end dates, quantities, fixing, and pricing data.

calculationPeriod.description: Period for which the payment is generated.

deliveryPeriod.description: Period and time profile over which the delivery takes place.

fixingPeriod.description: Period over which the underlying price is observed.
